instruction: Add a soft concentrated elemental spirit glow only at the ear tips, with at most a few tiny magical light points.

instruction: Make the same tail moderately longer and fuller while preserving its root position, direction, elemental effect and recognizable fur style.

instruction: Awaken and refine the existing small elemental lineage sigil on the forehead so it becomes slightly more luminous and mythic. Preserve its location and do not add a second unrelated symbol.
preserve_hint: Keep the forehead shape, fur direction, eyes and face identity unchanged.

instruction: Introduce sparse soft spirit-light traces and subtle elemental color variation inside the existing fur. Keep the effect localized and natural, never as a galaxy or starfield texture across the body.

instruction: Add a soft elemental spirit glow around the paw tips, as if gentle magical energy is held inside the fur.

instruction: Give the existing whiskers a faint magical luminescence with very small elemental highlights near the outer tips.
preserve_hint: Do not change the muzzle, mouth, nose or whisker root positions.

instruction: Add a tiny asymmetric group of soft magical freckles across the cheek fur. Keep them subtle and personal, not constellation-shaped or starfield-like.
preserve_hint: Keep the face shape, eyes, muzzle and expression unchanged.

instruction: Develop a slightly fuller guardian-like neck ruff with soft elemental shading and restrained spirit glow.
preserve_hint: Keep the head size, shoulder width and overall body proportions unchanged.

instruction: Evolve only the far end of the existing long fluffy tail into two soft distinct tips that share the same tail base and flow naturally together. Preserve the established elemental aura.
